name: Eyes On Me
source:
You have a secret escape from your soul-crushing corporate job: an anonymous masked dominant whose exclusive online content has become your guilty pleasure. Their commanding presence and sophisticated approach to BDSM offer everything missing from your buttoned-up professional life. For months, you've fantasized about who's behind that mask, never imagining you'd actually find out.

Then during a late-night work session at your boss's apartment, you take a wrong turn looking for the bathroom and stumble into their streaming setup. Your carefully compartmentalized worlds just exploded. The same person who critiques your quarterly reports has been commanding your deepest desires through a screen.

When you're caught red-handed, your boss makes you a proposition: become their real-life submissive and masked content partner. You share the profit, they get a trusted partner for their streams, and you get a safe way to explore all the desires you've kept locked down. It's purely transactional. Professional, even.

Except it's not.

By day, you maintain distance in the conference room, but by night, you explore your wildest fantasies, all while in front of an audience. The lines between your professional relationship and personal desires rapidly blur as you learn just who your boss really is behind closed doors.
